image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The subject displays a distinct oval shape with a reddish-brown leathery girdle surrounding eight overlapping, textured calcareous plates in the center. The background consists of rough, encrusted rock surfaces.
